name: xmemory-ai__xmemory-admin
description: Control plane for xmemory — create, list, inspect, and delete memory instances and generate their schemas. Instance and key management only: admin connections cannot read or write the data inside instances (use the main xmemory server for that). Includes destructive operations such as deleting an instance — use with care.

oauth_config.name: xmemory Admin MCP
oauth_config.description: xmemory admin MCP server (OAuth 2.1 + PKCE, dynamic client registration)

tools.name: admin_list_instance_memberships
tools.description: List visible cluster memberships for instances

tools.name: admin_edit_instance_memberships
tools.description: Edit instance cluster memberships within the key scope

tools.name: admin_generate_schema
tools.description: Generate a YAML schema from free-form text via LLM

tools.name: admin_enhance_schema
tools.description: Improve an existing YAML schema based on a text description

tools.name: admin_validate_yaml_schema
tools.description: Validate and repair XMD schema YAML you already have, without creating anything

tools.name: admin_convert_json_schema
tools.description: Convert a JSON Schema object to XMD schema YAML, without creating anything

tools.name: admin_create_instance
tools.description: Create a new memory instance

tools.name: admin_list_clusters
tools.description: List clusters accessible to the caller

tools.name: admin_get_cluster
tools.description: Get a single cluster by ID

tools.name: admin_list_api_keys
tools.description: List the API keys of the caller's user, with role, permissions, clusters and is_super_admin

tools.name: admin_get_api_key
tools.description: Show one API key of the caller's user: role, permissions, clusters and is_super_admin

tools.name: admin_create_api_key
tools.description: Create a key for the caller's user on one cluster, with a role no wider than the caller's; returns its secret once

tools.name: admin_list_mintable_roles
tools.description: List the API roles a key minted by this API key may have

tools.name: admin_list_instances
tools.description: List instances in a cluster

tools.name: admin_get_instance
tools.description: Get instance metadata

tools.name: admin_delete_instance
tools.description: Permanently delete an instance — cannot be undone

tools.name: admin_update_instance_metadata
tools.description: Replace an instance's name/description

tools.name: admin_patch_instance_metadata
tools.description: Partially update instance metadata

tools.name: admin_list_own_instances
tools.description: List all instances across linked clusters

tools.name: admin_get_instance_by_id
tools.description: Get an instance by ID (resolves its cluster)

tools.name: admin_delete_instance_by_id
tools.description: Permanently delete an instance by ID — cannot be undone

tools.name: admin_get_instance_schema_by_id
tools.description: Get a schema by instance ID (read-only fleet observability)

tools.name: admin_get_setup_instructions
tools.description: How to connect a given instance on another surface; never returns a credential

tools.name: admin_update_instance_metadata_by_id
tools.description: Update instance metadata by instance ID

tools.name: admin_patch_instance_metadata_by_id
tools.description: Patch instance metadata by instance ID
